tasks_completed.description: Change validator exit-code semantics so warnings-only canary trip exits 0; criticals exit non-zero (1); invocation/IO errors keep exit 2
tasks_completed.changes: Line 430: return 2 -> return 0 in the warnings-only branch of main(). Lines 11-13: docstring exit-code legend updated to match new contract (0=no critical errors with warnings allowed; 1=critical issues; 2=invocation/IO error).
tasks_completed.rationale: Root cause B1: prior author chose exit 2 for warnings-only as a tri-state signal, which violated AC2 literal text and standard CLI severity-alignment convention (eslint/mypy/ruff: warnings-only -> 0). BA confirmed zero shell callers and the only Python caller (sync-agent-data.py) uses importlib and never inspects exit code, so blast radius is nil.

git_rationale.root_cause_commit: B1: pre-existing (validator behavior since file creation)
git_rationale.why_issue_occurred: Validator emitted return 2 on warnings-only as a tri-state severity signal; AC2 literal text and standard CLI convention both expect 0.
git_rationale.how_fix_addresses_root: Surgical 1-character semantic change (return 2 -> return 0) at line 430; docstring legend updated at lines 11-13 to reflect the new contract so future readers do not re-introduce the old behavior.

dev.qa_notes: AC1 verified end-to-end via verbatim recipes below. No --strict flag exists in the validator (BA's optional preserve-clause is N/A for this codebase).
